newsitem.title: USA: Global Venture sets reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Global Venture sets reverse stock split.

text.p: Global Venture Funding Inc said Monday its board of directors has approved a one for 20 stock split of its common stock.
The company said in a statement that the reverse stock split will be effective at the opening of trading on August 20.
The stock will trade under the symbol GBVFD for 30 days after the split and will then revert back to its original symbol GBVF.
The company's non-trading preferred stock (series II, B, C and D) will also be split one for twenty with the same effective date.
